Manasik is a software platform built for Hajj & Umrah travel agencies. It brings pilgrim records, packages, QR ID cards, invoices and payments, branches and team roles, booking widgets, reports, multi-currency pricing and WhatsApp announcements together in one simple system — replacing the paperwork, spreadsheets and scattered chat threads agencies rely on today.
Running a Hajj or Umrah agency means caring for people on the most important journey of their lives. Yet much of the working day is still spent on manual paperwork — copying details between notebooks, spreadsheets and phone chats, chasing payments, and fixing the small errors that creep in whenever everything is done by hand.
Manasik exists to give that time back. When records, payments and communication live in one place, your team makes fewer mistakes, finds any pilgrim's details in seconds, and can spend its energy on serving pilgrims well — not on managing paper.
One platform for the whole agency — from the first enquiry to the journey home.

chunks.title: Privacy Policy — Manasik
chunks.text:
Last updated: October 2026
Manasik is a product of The Design PK. Manasik provides cloud software that helps Hajj and Umrah travel agencies manage pilgrims, packages, bookings, payments, groups and a pilgrim portal. This Privacy Policy explains what information the service holds, why it is held, and the rights and choices that apply.
Our office is at 28-E, Main Market, Gulberg II, Lahore, Pakistan. For privacy questions, contact us at info@thedesignpk.com.
# 2. Roles: your agency owns the data
Your agency decides what pilgrim data is collected and why. For that data, your agency is the owner and controller, and Manasik acts only as custodian and processor: we store and process it on your agency's instructions, in order to provide the software.
For the limited account data we hold about your agency itself — contact details, plan and billing records — Manasik is responsible for handling it as described in this policy.
# 3. Information the service holds
Account information: when an agency creates an account, we collect the agency name, contact email, phone number and address, and the full name of the person registering.

chunks.title: Privacy Policy — Manasik
chunks.text:
Pilgrim records: agencies enter pilgrim details into their dashboard — names, passport numbers, national ID numbers, phone numbers, dates of birth and addresses, together with booking, package, group and payment records. This data belongs to the agency; we hold it only so the software can work.
Pilgrim portal data: where an agency uses the pilgrim portal, the service holds the pilgrim's portal login details and the requests a pilgrim sends to their agency through the portal, such as correction requests, upgrade requests and service requests.
Documents: agencies may upload document copies — such as passports and visas — to the document vault for a pilgrim's booking and visa tracking.
Care information: an agency may record insurance details and medication information for a pilgrim's care. This information can be sensitive. It is visible only to the agency roles the agency itself permits, and it is used for no other purpose.
Subscription and payment records: we hold your agency's plan, invoices and payment status. Card and account payments are processed by our payment gateway; we do not store full card numbers.

chunks.title: Privacy Policy — Manasik
chunks.text:
Usage and technical data: we collect basic technical information, such as pages visited and actions taken, to keep the service secure and to improve it.
Communications: if you contact us for support, or subscribe to our newsletter, we hold the contact details and messages involved.
# 4. How information is used
We use the information described above solely to operate the Manasik platform: providing the dashboard and portal, processing bookings, keeping accounts secure, billing subscriptions, providing support, and communicating with agencies about the service.
Fully anonymised, combined statistics that cannot identify any agency or pilgrim may be used to improve the service.
# 5. Our data-trust commitments
We do not sell, rent or trade personal data — agency data or pilgrim data — to anyone, for any reason.
We never use pilgrim records for marketing, and we will never contact your pilgrims to promote Manasik or anything else.
We do not use agency or pilgrim data to train artificial intelligence models.
Your agency's booking and payment figures are used only to run your account and to provide support.

chunks.title: Privacy Policy — Manasik
chunks.text:
We handle personal data lawfully and only for the purposes described in this policy: to perform our contract with your agency, on your agency's instructions, with consent where consent is the appropriate basis, and where handling is needed to meet a legal obligation.
Pakistan does not yet have an enacted general data-protection law. We nevertheless follow the principles reflected in the draft Personal Data Protection Bill — lawful and fair processing, purpose limitation, data minimisation, accuracy, security safeguards, and respect for data-subject rights — as commitments of practice, and we will align this policy as the law develops.
# 7. Sharing and service providers
We share data only with the service providers needed to run Manasik, and only to the extent needed: hosting and database infrastructure (Supabase), application hosting (Vercel), payment processing for subscriptions (PayFast), and email delivery for service messages. These providers process data on our instructions and are not permitted to use it for their own purposes.

chunks.title: Privacy Policy — Manasik
chunks.text:
We may disclose information if required by law or a court order, or to protect the security of the service. We do not share agency or pilgrim data with anyone else.
We use essential cookies for sign-in sessions and language preference. On our public marketing website (www.getmanasik.com) only, we also use Google Analytics 4 (measurement ID: G-FHGSCSMD81), which sets analytics cookies (such as _ga) so we can count visits and understand how the website is used. Google Analytics is not used inside the dashboard or the app. We do not use advertising or cross-site tracking cookies.
# 9. Retention and deletion
You can export your agency's data from the dashboard at any time, in standard formats, without asking us, and without any export fee.
If your agency stops using Manasik, you may request complete deletion of your agency's data. We delete it, including from active systems, within 30 days of a verified request, except where the law requires us to retain specific records. Data in backups is removed in the ordinary backup cycle.
We will never hold your data hostage: no export fees, and no deletion conditions beyond verifying that the request comes from your agency.

chunks.title: Privacy Policy — Manasik
chunks.text:
All data is encrypted in transit (HTTPS/TLS) and encrypted at rest on our database infrastructure.
Each agency's records are isolated by database-level access controls (row-level security): your team can only ever see your own agency's data, and no other agency can access it.
Inside your agency, access follows the roles you assign — owners, admins and staff each see only what their role allows. Important actions inside the dashboard are recorded in an activity log.
Access by Manasik's own team is restricted to the minimum needed for technical support, security or legal obligations. We do not browse agency data for any other purpose.
If a security incident ever affects your agency's data, we will notify your agency without undue delay. Despite our safeguards, no online service can guarantee absolute security.
Agencies may view, correct or delete the pilgrim records in their dashboard at any time, and may export their agency's data at any time.

chunks.title: Privacy Policy — Manasik
chunks.text:
Pilgrims: your data in Manasik belongs to your travel agency, which is responsible for it. To exercise your rights over your own records — access, correction or deletion — please contact your agency first. We support agencies in responding to such requests, and you may also contact us using the details in section 15.
To request deletion of your agency account and all of its data, contact us using the details in section 15; deletion is completed within 30 days of verification.
# 12. International processing
Our infrastructure providers may store or process data in countries other than Pakistan. Where they do, data remains protected by the safeguards described in this policy, including encryption and access controls.
Manasik is sold to businesses, not to individual consumers. Pilgrim records entered by an agency may include children travelling with their family; those records receive exactly the same protections described in this policy.
# 14. Changes to this policy
If we change this policy, we will post the updated version on this page. If a change is material, we will notify agencies through their account contact details.

chunks.text: For privacy questions or requests, contact us at info@thedesignpk.com, or write to The Design PK, 28-E, Main Market, Gulberg II, Lahore, Pakistan.

Holding the licences, enrolments and approvals your agency needs — and complying with the Hajj and Umrah rules of Pakistan, Saudi Arabia and any other relevant authority — is your agency's own duty. Manasik does not assume any of those obligations.
You agree to use Manasik only for lawful business purposes. You must not attempt to access another agency's data, disrupt or probe the service's security, store unlawful content, misuse the pilgrim portal or credentials issued through it, or resell access to the platform.
